landing.headline: Medical paperwork shouldn't feel like a foreign language.
landing.subcopy: Translate prescriptions, blood tests, and hospital bills into clear, simple language instantly.
landing.trustText: Your documents are private and never shared.
landing.cardLine2Text: Three times daily by mouth x 7 days
landing.workflowSub: MedDecode AI translates documents securely in three key stages.
landing.stage1Text: Uploaded images and PDFs are parsed securely. The system extracts text structures using localized OCR to ensure patient records remain private.
landing.stage2Text: Clinical jargon and shorthand abbreviations (like QD, BD, TDS) are mapped and expanded to their full, correct medical definitions.
landing.stage3Text: Using secure generative models, the raw text is translated into clear summaries, highlighting potential warning flags and suggested questions for your doctor.
landing.demoSub: Test how MedDecode AI works instantly with realistic sample medical records.
landing.awaitingText: Click the **Run MedDecode Translation** button on the left to test this document sample instantly.
landing.vaultTitle: Access Your Personal Medical History Vault
landing.vaultText: Every document you scan is indexed securely inside your dashboard. Search files by name, filter by medical categories, view prior translations, and permanently delete records at any time. We support guest sessions as well as email registrations.
landing.standardsText: To guarantee precision for clinical shorthand abbreviations and OCR reading speed, MedDecode AI's text extraction and translation pipelines are tailored explicitly to parse English medical documents. All OCR processing runs locally to respect patient confidentiality.
landing.standardsTip: Document translation and abbreviation mappings run on private medical models. In-app document loading is restricted to English-language layouts.
landing.faqSub: Clear answers regarding privacy, accuracy, and platform rules.
landing.ctaTitle: Get clarity on your medical records today.
landing.ctaSub: Upload your files securely. Get structured, patient-friendly explanations in seconds. Supports guest login.
landing.footerText: Translating clinical shorthand, prescriptions, and lab panels into plain, patient-friendly English instantly.
landing.processingSub: Reading abbreviations, standard clinical references, and building plain summaries...

consent.title: Terms & Privacy Consent
consent.subtitle: Please review and accept to unlock medical document analysis
consent.errorMsg: You must accept all terms, policies, and disclosures to proceed.
consent.text1: MedDecode AI provides automatic translations of medical records. **This application does not diagnose diseases, recommend treatment, prescribe medicines, or replace human doctors.** Always consult a qualified healthcare professional regarding any clinical concerns.
consent.text2: Your medical documents are processed securely and stored in encrypted private storage buckets. We implement Row Level Security (RLS) policies to prevent cross-user data access. Your records will never be made public.
consent.text3: We leverage advanced language processing technology (OpenAI API) to read, categorize, and explain medical reports. AI models can occasionally produce inaccuracies or incomplete translations. All output must be verified with certified sources.
consent.text4: In compliance with digital privacy standards (including GDPR, HIPAA, and DPDP rules), you can permanently delete any document or completely close your account. This permanently wipes all files from our storage buckets.
consent.faq1Q: Is my medical data secure and private?
consent.faq1A: Yes. All uploaded documents are stored in private, encrypted Supabase storage buckets. We implement strict Row-Level Security (RLS) policies, meaning only you can access your records. In compliance with data privacy standards, you can permanently delete any document or your entire account at any time.
consent.faq2Q: Can MedDecode AI replace my doctor?
consent.faq2A: No. MedDecode AI is strictly an educational tool designed to help you understand complex medical terminology, clinical shorthand, and billing codes. It does not diagnose conditions, prescribe medications, or recommend treatments. Always consult a qualified healthcare provider for clinical decisions.
consent.faq3Q: What kinds of medical documents are supported?
consent.faq3A: We support a wide variety of documents including doctor prescriptions, pharmacy labels, blood tests, metabolic panels, hospital bills, insurance Explanation of Benefits (EOB) statements, and discharge summaries.
consent.faq4Q: How does the explanation translation process work?
consent.faq4A: When you upload a file, the platform performs optical character recognition (OCR) securely. It then parses clinical abbreviations (like QD or TDS) into their full names and runs the text through advanced generative AI models (Gemini API) to produce structured, patient-friendly summaries.
